## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `usage_record`. One of `usage_record`. |
| `id` | `string` | The usage record id. |
| `subscription` | `string` | The subscription id. |
| `item` | `string` | The subscription item id. Null after the item was removed from the subscription. The record stays. |
| `price` | `string` | The metered price id. Null only if the price was deleted. |
| `quantity` | `integer` | The quantity used. |
| `unique_key` | `string` | Your own key for the event. Repeats with the same key do nothing. |
| `operation` | `string` | add, or remove for a unique key that left. |
| `timestamp` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the usage happened. |
| `note` | `string` | A note on the event. |
| `invoice` | `string` | The invoice that billed the usage, or null if not billed. |
| `created_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | When the record was created. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | usage_record |
| `404` | No such usage record |
